summary: Tested (1) Checkout card_pos payment option for pickup/delivery and (2) admin Orders sound toggle + card_pos display + new-order badge. All features work as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx correctly resets payment='cash' if user switches to delivery while card_pos selected (useEffect on mode).
Backend server.py:301 correctly rejects payment_method='card_pos' when mode != 'pickup' with 400.
sound.js gracefully swallows AudioContext errors; no uncaught exceptions observed when playNewOrderSound runs.
Minor pre-existing (unrelated to this review): hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in Checkout zone select — cosmetic, not a functional bug.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed pickup orders (card_pos and cash) via /api/orders for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkout pay-card-pos option only visible on pickup mode. Backend enforces mode=pickup for card_pos (400 on delivery). Admin /admin/orders shows data-testid=sound-toggle with default 'Ήχος ON', toggles to 'Ήχος OFF', persists in localStorage tc_admin_sound across reload. Order detail panel shows 'Πληρωμή: Κάρτα στο κατάστημα' for card_pos orders. new-orders-badge appears within seconds of a new order (polling).
